expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists at local/plans/<kebab-case-english-slug>.md
The plan has a Requirement section with hand-over, fallback, depth, judge (A/B test) and needs
expectations.evidence: 计划包含「交付物」「A/B 测试设计」「需要你确认」，但没有明确的深度要求，也未保留用户接受的「只改首屏标题」退路。

expectations.text: The plan has all five Task slots filled from the user's answer
expectations.evidence: 五项内容均已体现：「注册率 1.9% → 3.5%」、「B2B 协作工具」及 Notion 差异、只用 support + analytics、三项禁止边界、3 组标题与副标题由用户挑选后进入 A/B。

expectations.text: The plan's Ready line is yes
expectations.evidence: plan.md 没有 Ready 行；末节为「需要你确认」，列出三个待确认问题。

expectations.text: The plan is short (one screen, roughly under 60 lines)
expectations.evidence: plan.md 共 81 行，包含编号 0–7 的八个章节，超过约 60 行的一屏短计划要求。

expectations.text: The plan is written in Chinese
expectations.evidence: 正文以中文撰写，例如「诊断（0.5–1 天，先于写文案）」「你挑 1 版后，才进入 A/B」。
